table_title: Capacity table (elevation, in feet, and contents, in acre-feet)
location_text: Lat 39°11'53", long 123°10'50", in Yokaya Grant, Mendocino County, Hydrologic Unit 18010110, in intake tower 30 ft (9 m) upstream from Coyote Dam on East Fork Russian River, and 3.6 mi (5.8 km) northeast of Ukiah.
notes: Sampled table is the capacity (elevation-contents) table, not the daily contents table below it; it has no dates. Remarks say: capacity based on 1975 resurvey, new capacity table put into use July 1, 1977; the page is for water year October 1977 to September 1978. Years set to none because the table is not a measurement series; a checker may prefer 1977-1978 (years the table was in use on this page). Heading 'RUSSIAN RIVER BASIN'.
